description: What a candidate must show before it may replace the reference, on real data and with the same assumptions as the reference. The thresholds are the review's proposal; the repository owner confirms or changes them in a pull request, never in the middle of a promotion.

structural.description: A candidate that only removes rules, overlays, guards or optional parameters, or changes a categorical choice, and moves no number. It searched nothing, so no walk-forward folds or holdout look are asked of it; instead it may trail the reference on the real data by at most these margins, and not at all in the median over a fixed suite of synthetic histories.
